<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0">
    <meta http-equiv="Pragma" content="no-cache">
    <meta http-equiv="Expires" content="0">
    <title>Vitalismen Automacao</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            color-scheme: light;
            --bg: #eef2f6;
            --surface: #ffffff;
            --surface-soft: #f7f9fc;
            --line: #d7dee8;
            --text: #1d2733;
            --muted: #667488;
            --blue: #1c5fd6;
            --blue-soft: #e9f1ff;
            --green: #107a4a;
            --green-soft: #e8f7ef;
            --orange: #a65d00;
            --orange-soft: #fff1df;
            --red: #b42318;
            --red-soft: #fff0ee;
            --ink: #0d1420;
            --shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            margin: 0;
            min-height: 100vh;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
        }

        body.funnel-manager-active {
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        button,
        input,
        select,
        textarea {
            font: inherit;
        }

        button {
            min-height: 34px;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: var(--surface);
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 0 11px;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        button:hover {
            background: var(--surface-soft);
            border-color: #b8c2d0;
        }

        button.primary {
            background: var(--blue);
            border-color: var(--blue);
            color: #fff;
        }

        button.success {
            background: var(--green);
            border-color: var(--green);
            color: #fff;
        }

        button.danger {
            color: var(--red);
        }

        button:disabled {
            cursor: wait;
            opacity: 0.55;
        }

        input,
        select,
        textarea {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 36px;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: #fff;
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 0 10px;
        }

        textarea {
            min-height: 78px;
            padding: 10px;
            resize: vertical;
        }

        .app {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
        }

        .topbar {
            min-height: 64px;
            background: var(--surface);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 18px;
            padding: 0 18px;
        }

        .brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            min-width: 220px;
        }

        .brand-mark {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            background: var(--ink);
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        h1,
        h2,
        h3,
        p {
            margin: 0;
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: 18px;
            letter-spacing: 0;
        }

        h2 {
            font-size: 16px;
            letter-spacing: 0;
        }

        h3 {
            font-size: 14px;
            letter-spacing: 0;
        }

        .subtitle,
        .meta {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .top-actions,
        .row,
        .actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .top-actions {
            position: relative;
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }

        .zapi-fixed-status {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 30px;
            border: 1px solid #b7ebc6;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: #e9fbea;
            color: #006c55;
            padding: 0 10px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex: 0 0 auto;
        }

        .country-switch {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            min-height: 34px;
            border: 1px solid #b8d8ff;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: #f4f9ff;
            padding: 0 9px 0 12px;
            color: #1d4ed8;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .country-switch.main-country {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
        }

        .country-switch select {
            min-height: 24px;
            border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: #fff;
            padding: 0 22px 0 10px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--ink);
        }

        .module-nav {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
            flex: 1 1 auto;
        }

        .module-nav button,
        .module-nav a,
        .top-actions a {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 32px;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            color: var(--text);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 0 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .module-nav button.active,
        .module-nav a.active {
            background: var(--ink);
            border-color: var(--ink);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 24px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            padding: 0 9px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            background: var(--blue-soft);
            color: var(--blue);
        }

        .badge.green {
            background: var(--green-soft);
            color: var(--green);
        }

        .badge.orange {
            background: var(--orange-soft);
            color: var(--orange);
        }

        .badge.red {
            background: var(--red-soft);
            color: var(--red);
        }

        .badge.neutral {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            color: #475569;
        }

        .badge.blue {
            background: #e9f1ff;
            color: #1c5fd6;
            border: 1px solid #bfd6ff;
        }

        .badge.sent {
            background: #eef2ff;
            color: #3730a3;
            border: 1px solid #c7d2fe;
        }

        .badge.attending {
            background: #ecfeff;
            color: #0e7490;
            border: 1px solid #a5f3fc;
        }

        .badge.confirmed {
            background: #f5f3ff;
            color: #6d28d9;
            border: 1px solid #ddd6fe;
        }

        .badge.repurchase {
            background: #fdf2f8;
            color: #be185d;
            border: 1px solid #fbcfe8;
        }

        .badge.returned {
            background: #fff7ed;
            color: #9a3412;
            border: 1px solid #fed7aa;
        }

        .ops-alert-button {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            min-height: 32px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
            background: #ecfdf5;
            color: #047857;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 950;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding: 0 11px;
        }

        .ops-alert-button::before {
            content: "";
            width: 9px;
            height: 9px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: currentColor;
        }

        .ops-alert-button.attention {
            border-color: #fed7aa;
            background: #fff7ed;
            color: #c2410c;
        }

        .ops-alert-button.blocked {
            border-color: #fecaca;
            background: #fef2f2;
            color: #b42318;
        }

        .ops-alert-button.active::before {
            animation: opsAlertPulse 1s ease-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes opsAlertPulse {
            0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.36); }
            70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0); }
            100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(220, 38, 38, 0); }
        }

        .ops-alert-popover {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(100% + 8px);
            right: 0;
            width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 24px));
            max-height: min(520px, calc(100vh - 96px));
            overflow: auto;
            background: #fff;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.24);
            padding: 10px;
            z-index: 80;
        }

        .ops-alert-head {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 2px 2px 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .ops-alert-list {
            display: grid;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .ops-alert-item {
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 9px;
            background: #f8fafc;
        }

        .ops-alert-item.blocked {
            border-color: #fecaca;
            background: #fff5f5;
        }

        .ops-alert-item.attention,
        .ops-alert-item.paused {
            border-color: #fed7aa;
            background: #fff7ed;
        }

        .ops-alert-client-list {
            display: grid;
            gap: 6px;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .ops-alert-client {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 38px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 7px 8px;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .ops-alert-client strong,
        .ops-alert-client span {
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .ops-alert-client em {
            font-style: normal;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #2563eb;
        }

        .shell {
            height: calc(100vh - 64px);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 480px minmax(360px, 1fr) 380px;
            grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 12px;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .shell.module-care {
            grid-template-columns: minmax(720px, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
        }

        .shell.module-sales,
        .shell.module-connections,
        .shell.module-admin {
            grid-template-columns: minmax(720px, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
        }

        .shell .lead-dashboard-panel {
            display: none;
        }

        .shell.module-care > aside.contact-pane,
        .shell.module-care > section.chat-pane,
        .shell.module-care #operationPanel,
        .shell.module-care .ops-strip,
        .shell.module-sales > aside.contact-pane,
        .shell.module-sales > aside:first-child,
        .shell.module-sales > section.panel,
        .shell.module-connections > aside.contact-pane,
        .shell.module-connections > aside:first-child,
        .shell.module-connections > section.panel,
        .shell.module-admin > aside.contact-pane,
        .shell.module-admin > aside:first-child,
        .shell.module-admin > section.panel {
            display: none;
        }

        .shell.module-sales #operationPanel,
        .shell.module-connections #operationPanel,
        .shell.module-admin #operationPanel {
            max-height: none;
        }

        .shell.module-all .integrated-hidden,
        .shell.module-all .ops-secondary,
        .shell.module-all .ops-metrics-section,
        .shell.module-all #dropiSection,
        .shell.module-all #userAdminSection,
        .shell.module-all #operationPanel > .panel-head {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .shell.module-sales .ops-strip,
        .shell.module-sales .ops-secondary,
        .shell.module-sales .ops-metrics-section,
        .shell.module-sales #userAdminSection,
        .shell.module-sales #connectionsSection,
        .shell.module-sales .customer-section {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .shell.module-care .lead-dashboard-panel {
            display: flex;
        }

        .lead-dashboard-panel .panel-head {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
        }

        .lead-dashboard-frame {
            width: 100%;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            border: 0;
            background: #0f0f10;
        }

        .shell.module-sales #operationPanel {
            display: flex;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .shell.module-sales #dropiSection .shipment-list {
            max-height: calc(100vh - 270px);
        }

        .shell.module-admin #operationPanel > .side-section:not(#userAdminSection) {
            display: none;
        }

        .shell.module-admin #userAdminSection {
            display: grid !important;
        }

        .shell.module-connections #operationPanel {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .shell.module-connections .ops-strip,
        .shell.module-connections #operationPanel > .panel-head {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .shell.module-connections #operationPanel > .side-section:not(#connectionsSection) {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .shell.module-connections #connectionsSection {
            display: grid !important;
            align-content: start;
            gap: 14px;
            padding: 18px;
            min-height: 100%;
        }

        .panel {
            min-width: 0;
            min-height: 0;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .panel-head {
            min-height: 52px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
            padding: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .panel-body {
            min-height: 0;
            overflow: auto;
            padding: 12px;
        }

        .login-panel {
            width: min(460px, calc(100vw - 32px));
            margin: 56px auto;
            display: block;
        }

        .login-form {
            display: grid;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .login-form label {
            display: grid;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .wa-card {
            display: grid;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
            background: var(--surface-soft);
        }

        .qr-image {
            width: 210px;
            height: 210px;
            display: none;
            justify-self: center;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 8px;
            background: #fff;
        }

        .connection-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .connection-card {
            min-width: 0;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
            padding: 14px;
            display: grid;
            gap: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
        }

        .connection-card-head {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .connection-status-button {
            width: 100%;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 48px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 900;
            white-space: normal;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: default;
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .connection-status-button.connected {
            border-color: var(--green);
            background: var(--green);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .connection-status-button.disconnected {
            border-color: var(--red);
            background: var(--red);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .connection-order-status {
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: var(--surface-soft);
            padding: 10px;
            display: grid;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .connection-order-status-head {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .connection-order-status-head strong {
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .connection-order-status-head span {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 800;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .connection-order-status-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .connection-order-pill {
            min-width: 0;
            border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.36);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: #fff;
            padding: 7px 6px;
            display: grid;
            gap: 2px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .connection-order-pill strong {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .connection-order-pill span {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 900;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .connection-order-actions {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .connection-order-action {
            border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.24);
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
            color: var(--blue-dark);
            padding: 5px 8px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .connection-card-muted {
            background: #f8fafc;
            box-shadow: none;
        }

        .connection-ops {
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: var(--surface-soft);
            padding: 10px;
            display: grid;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .connection-ops-panel {
            margin-top: 1cm;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
            padding-top: 14px;
            display: grid;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .connection-ops-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .connection-ops-panel h4 {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 13px;
            letter-spacing: 0;
        }

        .connection-ops-table-wrap {
            overflow: auto;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
        }

        .connection-ops-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            min-width: 920px;
        }

        .connection-ops-table th,
        .connection-ops-table td {
            padding: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
            text-align: left;
            vertical-align: top;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .connection-ops-table th {
            background: var(--surface-soft);
            color: var(--muted);
            font-weight: 900;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .connection-ops-table tr:last-child td {
            border-bottom: 0;
        }

        .connection-ops-clients {
            max-height: 120px;
            overflow: auto;
            display: grid;
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .connection-ops-head {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 8px;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .connection-attendant {
            display: grid;
            gap: 2px;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .connection-attendant strong {
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .connection-attendant span {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--muted);
        }

        .connection-alert {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 900;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--muted);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .connection-alert-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: #94a3b8;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.32);
        }

        .connection-alert.new .connection-alert-dot,
        .connection-alert.active .connection-alert-dot {
            background: var(--green);
        }

        .connection-alert.waiting .connection-alert-dot {
            background: #f59e0b;
        }

        .connection-alert.stale .connection-alert-dot {
            background: var(--red);
        }

        .connection-alert.new .connection-alert-dot,
        .connection-alert.waiting .connection-alert-dot,
        .connection-alert.stale .connection-alert-dot {
            animation: connectionPulse 1.2s ease-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes connectionPulse {
            0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22); }
            70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0); }
            100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(37, 99, 235, 0); }
        }

        .connection-metrics {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .connection-metric {
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: #fff;
            padding: 6px;
            display: grid;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .connection-metric strong {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .connection-metric span {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .connection-client-list {
            max-height: 168px;
            overflow: auto;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
            padding-top: 6px;
        }

        .connection-client-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(92px, 1fr) minmax(72px, auto) 44px;
            gap: 6px;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 24px;
            font-size: 11px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.72);
        }

        .connection-client-row:last-child {
            border-bottom: 0;
        }

        .connection-client-name {
            min-width: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .connection-client-stage {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-weight: 800;
            text-align: right;
        }

        .connection-client-time {
            color: var(--muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .connection-qr {
            width: 190px;
            height: 190px;
            display: none;
            justify-self: center;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);

        async function loadUsers() {
            if (!state.token || state.user?.role !== 'admin') return;

            state.users = data.users || [];
            renderUsers();

        async function createUser(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (state.user?.role !== 'admin') return;

                name: el('newUserName').value.trim(),
                email: el('newUserEmail').value.trim(),
                role: el('newUserRole').value,
                password: el('newUserPassword').value
            };

        async function updateUser(userId, changes) {
            await api(`/api/auth/users/${encodeURIComponent(userId)}`, {
                method: 'PATCH',
                body: JSON.stringify(changes)
            });
            await loadUsers();
        }

        const setQrState = (target, status, qrCode) => {
            if (!target?.status || !target?.image || !target?.help) return;
            target.status.textContent = `${status.toUpperCase()} | ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR')}`;
            if (status === 'connected') {
                state.lastQrCode = '';
                state.lastQrAt = 0;
                target.image.style.display = 'none';
                target.help.classList.add('hidden');
            } else if (qrCode) {
                state.lastQrCode = qrCode;
                state.lastQrAt = Date.now();
                target.image.src = qrCode;
                target.image.style.display = 'block';
                target.help.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else if (['scanning', 'qr', 'connecting'].includes(status) && state.lastQrCode && Date.now() - state.lastQrAt < 90000) {
                target.image.src = state.lastQrCode;
                target.image.style.display = 'block';
                target.help.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else if (status === 'logged_out') {
                state.lastQrCode = '';
                state.lastQrAt = 0;
                target.image.style.display = 'none';
                target.help.textContent = 'Sessao desconectada. Reinicie a conexao para gerar um novo QR.';
                target.help.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                target.image.style.display = 'none';
                target.help.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        };

        const setZapiLoginState = (target, zapi) => {
            if (!target?.status || !target?.image || !target?.help) return;
            const connected = Boolean(zapi?.ok);
            const phone = zapi?.device?.phone || '';
            const name = zapi?.device?.name || 'Z-API';
            const errorDetail = zapi?.status?.error || zapi?.originalStatus?.error || zapi?.error?.error || zapi?.error || '';
            target.status.textContent = `Z-API ${connected ? 'CONECTADO' : 'OFFLINE'} | ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR')}`;
            target.image.style.display = 'none';
            target.image.removeAttribute('src');
            target.help.textContent = connected
                ? `Numero conectado: ${phone || 'sem numero'}${name ? ' · ' + name : ''}`
                : `Conecte o celular na Z-API. ${errorDetail ? 'Status: ' + errorDetail : 'Este painel apenas puxa o status da integracao.'}`;
            target.help.classList.remove('hidden');
        };

        const cleanPanelResponsePreview = (value = '') => String(value || '')
            .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
            .trim()
            .slice(0, 110);

        async function fetchPanelJson(path, options = {}) {
            const { label = path, ...fetchOptions } = options;
            const headers = {
                ...(state.token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${state.token}` } : {}),
                ...(fetchOptions.headers || {})
            };
            const response = await fetch(path, {
                cache: 'no-store',
                credentials: 'same-origin',
                ...fetchOptions,
                headers
            });
            const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
            const text = await response.text();
            let data = {};
            if (text) {
                try {
                    data = JSON.parse(text);
                } catch (parseError) {
                    const preview = cleanPanelResponsePreview(text);
                    const error = new Error(`${label}: resposta ${response.status || 'sem status'} nao JSON${preview ? ` (${preview})` : ''}`);
                    error.status = response.status;
                    error.contentType = contentType;
                    error.preview = preview;
                    throw error;
                }
            }
            if (!response.ok) {
                if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
                    setAuth('');
                    const error = new Error('Sessão expirada. Entre novamente.');
                    error.status = response.status;
                    error.response = data;
                    throw error;
                }
                const error = new Error(data.error || data.message || `${label}: erro ${response.status}`);
                error.status = response.status;
                error.response = data;
                throw error;
            }
            return data;
        }

        const zapiStatusGraceMs = 120000;

        async function checkStatus() {
            if (!state.token) {
                setSignedOutZapiState();
                renderOperationalAlerts();
                return;
            }
            try {
                const ts = Date.now();
                const zapiStatus = await fetchPanelJson(`/api/zapi/status?_=${ts}`, { label: 'Z-API status' });
                const statusData = zapiStatus?.status || {};
                const errorDetail = String(statusData.error || zapiStatus?.error || '').toLowerCase();
                const alreadyConnected = errorDetail.includes('already connected');
                const connected = Boolean(
                    zapiStatus?.ok
                    && statusData.connected === true
                    && statusData.smartphoneConnected !== false
                    && (statusData.session !== false || alreadyConnected)
                );
                const zapi = {
                    ...zapiStatus,
                    ok: connected,
                    error: connected ? '' : zapiStatus?.error,
                    device: zapiStatus?.device || {
                        phone: statusData.phone || '',
                        name: statusData.source || 'Z-API',
                        isBusiness: false,
                        originalDevice: '',
                        sessionName: ''
                    }
                };
                state.zapiDevice = zapi || null;
                if (connected) {
                    state.lastZapiOkAt = Date.now();
                    state.lastZapiSnapshot = zapi;
                    state.lastZapiStatusError = '';
                }
                const status = connected ? 'connected' : 'disconnected';
                document.body.classList.toggle('zapi-offline', !connected);

                el('waBadge').textContent = connected ? 'Z-API' : 'OFFLINE';
                el('waBadge').className = `badge ${badgeClass(status)}`;
                setZapiLoginState({ status: el('statusText'), image: el('qrcode'), help: el('qrHelp') }, zapi);
                setZapiLoginState({ status: el('loginStatusText'), image: el('loginQrcode'), help: el('loginQrHelp') }, zapi);
            } catch (error) {
                const now = Date.now();
                const hasFreshConnectedStatus = Boolean(state.lastZapiSnapshot?.ok && state.lastZapiOkAt && now - state.lastZapiOkAt < zapiStatusGraceMs);
                const message = error.message || 'Falha ao ler status Z-API';
                state.lastZapiStatusError = message;
                if (hasFreshConnectedStatus) {
                    document.body.classList.remove('zapi-offline');
                    el('waBadge').textContent = 'Z-API';
                    el('waBadge').className = 'badge green';
                    const staleStatus = {
                        ...state.lastZapiSnapshot,
                        transientStatusError: message
                    };
                    state.zapiDevice = staleStatus;
                    const lastTime = new Date(state.lastZapiOkAt).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR');
                    const stableText = `Z-API CONECTADO | ultima leitura ${lastTime}`;
                    el('statusText').textContent = stableText;
                    el('loginStatusText').textContent = stableText;
                    return;
                }
                document.body.classList.add('zapi-offline');
                el('waBadge').textContent = 'ERRO';
                el('waBadge').className = 'badge red';
                el('statusText').textContent = message;
                el('loginStatusText').textContent = message;
                state.zapiDevice = { ok: false, error: message };
            }
            renderOperationalAlerts();
        }

        const normalizeAlertKind = (kind = '') => {
            const value = String(kind || '').toLowerCase();
            if (['blocked', 'critical', 'error', 'red'].includes(value)) return 'blocked';
            if (['attention', 'warning', 'paused', 'orange'].includes(value)) return 'attention';
            return 'info';
        };

        const addOperationalAlert = (alerts, { kind = 'attention', label = 'Aviso', detail = '', source = '', items = [] } = {}) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAlertKind(kind);
            const key = `${normalized}:${label}:${detail}`;
            if (alerts.some((item) => item.key === key)) return;
            alerts.push({
                key,
                kind: normalized,
                label: String(label || 'Aviso'),
                detail: String(detail || ''),
                source: String(source || ''),
                items: Array.isArray(items) ? items : []
            });
        };

        const operationalAlertClientItem = ({ kind = '', phone = '', chatId = '', orderId = '', name = '', reason = '', detail = '' } = {}) => ({
            kind: String(kind || ''),
            phone: String(phone || '').replace(/\D/g, ''),
            chatId: String(chatId || ''),
            orderId: String(orderId || ''),
            name: String(name || '').trim(),
            reason: String(reason || '').replace(/_/g, ' '),
            detail: String(detail || '').trim()
        });

        const buildOperationalAlerts = () => {
            const alerts = [];
            const zapi = state.zapiDevice;
            if (!zapi) {
                addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                    kind: 'attention',
                    label: 'WhatsApp verificando',
                    detail: 'Status da Z-API ainda nao carregou nesta tela.',
                    source: 'WhatsApp'
                });
            } else if (!zapi.ok) {
                addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                    kind: 'blocked',
                    label: 'WhatsApp desconectado',
                    detail: zapi.error || 'Z-API nao confirmou conexao do aparelho.',
                    source: 'WhatsApp'
                });
            }

            const status = state.automationStatus;
            if (!status) {
                addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                    kind: 'attention',
                    label: 'Automacao verificando',
                    detail: 'Status geral ainda nao carregou nesta tela.',
                    source: 'Automacao'
                });
                return alerts;
            }

            const flags = status.flags || {};
            const counts = status.counts || {};
            const manualReviewOrders = Array.isArray(status.manualReviewOrders) ? status.manualReviewOrders : [];
            const manualReviewItems = manualReviewOrders.map((order) => operationalAlertClientItem({
                kind: 'manual_review',
                phone: order.phone || '',
                orderId: order.orderId || '',
                name: order.clientName || 'sem nome',
                reason: order.reason || order.reviewStatus || 'revisar'
            }));
            const reengagementItems = (Array.isArray(status.reengagementCandidates) ? status.reengagementCandidates : []).map((candidate) => operationalAlertClientItem({
                kind: 'reengagement',
                phone: candidate.phone || '',
                chatId: candidate.chatId || '',
                name: candidate.phone || candidate.chatId || 'cliente',
                detail: candidate.lastInboundText || '',
                reason: candidate.ageHours ? `${candidate.ageHours}h sem resposta humana` : 'retomar atendimento'
            }));
            const manualReviewDetail = manualReviewItems.length
                ? `${manualReviewItems.length} pedido(s) precisam revisao humana. Clique no cliente para abrir.`
                : `${counts.manualSendRequired || 0} pedido(s) precisam acao humana antes de seguir.`;
            if (flags.scheduler && !flags.scheduler.enabled) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'blocked', label: 'Agendador pausado', detail: 'Ciclos automaticos nao estao rodando.', source: 'Scheduler' });
            if (flags.autoReply && !flags.autoReply.enabled) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'blocked', label: 'IA sem auto-resposta', detail: 'WHATSAPP_AUTO_REPLY_ENABLED esta desligado.', source: 'IA' });
            if (flags.funnel && !flags.funnel.enabled) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'attention', label: 'Funil pausado', detail: 'WHATSAPP_FUNNEL_ENABLED esta desligado.', source: 'Funil' });
            if (flags.shipments && !flags.shipments.enabled) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'attention', label: 'Avisos de pedido pausados', detail: 'Avisos de guia, retirada e entrega nao estao ativos.', source: 'Pedidos' });
            if (flags.whatsappQueue && !flags.whatsappQueue.globalEnabled) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'attention', label: 'Fila WhatsApp pausada', detail: 'Fila global humanizada nao esta ativa.', source: 'WhatsApp' });
            if ((counts.dropiPaymentRequired || 0) > 0) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'blocked', label: 'Dropi aguardando saldo', detail: `${counts.dropiPaymentRequired} pedido(s) parados por saldo.`, source: 'Dropi' });
            if ((counts.manualSendRequired || 0) > 0) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'blocked', label: 'Pedido exige revisao manual', detail: manualReviewDetail, source: 'Pedidos', items: manualReviewItems });
            if ((counts.shipmentDispatchCandidates || 0) > 0) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'attention', label: 'Avisos pendentes', detail: `${counts.shipmentDispatchCandidates} aviso(s) de guia, retirada, entrega ou devolucao pendente(s).`, source: 'Pedidos' });
            if ((counts.pickupReminderCandidates || 0) > 0) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'attention', label: 'Lembretes de retirada pendentes', detail: `${counts.pickupReminderCandidates} lembrete(s) aguardando fila segura.`, source: 'Pedidos' });
            if ((counts.reengagementCandidates || 0) > 0) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'attention', label: 'Clientes aguardando retomada', detail: `${counts.reengagementCandidates} conversa(s) candidatas a retomada segura.`, source: 'Atendimento', items: reengagementItems });
            if ((counts.adminPanelAtendimentoGaps || 0) > 0) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'attention', label: 'Atendimento fora de sincronia', detail: `${counts.adminPanelAtendimentoGaps} lead(s) precisam sincronizar com o painel.`, source: 'Painel' });
            if ((counts.whatsappQueue || 0) > 50) addOperationalAlert(alerts, { kind: 'blocked', label: 'Fila WhatsApp alta', detail: `${counts.whatsappQueue} tarefa(s) pendente(s) na fila.`, source: 'WhatsApp' });

            (status.dropiBlockedOrders || []).forEach((order) => {
                const reason = String(order.reason || '').slice(0, 220);
                if (/dropi_auth_required|pagina no disponible|página no disponible|manual/i.test(reason)) {
                    addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                        kind: 'blocked',
                        label: `Dropi revisar ${order.orderId || ''}`.trim(),
                        detail: reason || 'Pedido bloqueado na automacao Dropi.',
                        source: 'Dropi'
                    });
                }
            });

            (status.notes || []).forEach((note) => {
                const kind = normalizeAlertKind(note.kind);
                if (!['blocked', 'attention'].includes(kind)) return;
                addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                    kind,
                    label: note.label || 'Aviso operacional',
                    detail: note.detail || '',
                    source: 'Automacao'
                });
            });

            return alerts.slice(0, 12);
        };

        const renderOperationalAlertClients = (items = []) => {
            const safeItems = (Array.isArray(items) ? items : [])
                .filter((item) => item.phone || item.chatId || item.orderId)
                .slice(0, 8);
            if (!safeItems.length) return '';
            return `
                <div class="ops-alert-client-list">
                    ${safeItems.map((item) => {

                            : (phone || item.chatId || item.orderId || 'cliente');
                        const reason = item.reason || item.detail || 'abrir atendimento';
                        return `
                            <button class="ops-alert-client" type="button"
                                data-ops-alert-kind="${escapeHtml(item.kind || '')}"
                                data-ops-alert-phone="${escapeHtml(phone)}"

                                data-ops-alert-order-id="${escapeHtml(item.orderId || '')}">
                                <span>
                                    <strong class="truncate">${escapeHtml(title)}</strong>
                                    <span class="meta truncate">${escapeHtml(reason)}</span>
                                </span>
                                <em>Atender</em>
                            </button>
                        `;
                    }).join('')}
                </div>
            `;
        };

        const renderOperationalAlerts = () => {
            const btn = el('opsAlertBtn');
            const popover = el('opsAlertPopover');
            if (!btn || !popover) return;
            const alerts = buildOperationalAlerts();
            state.operationalAlerts = alerts;
            const hasBlocked = alerts.some((item) => item.kind === 'blocked');
            const severity = hasBlocked ? 'blocked' : alerts.length ? 'attention' : 'ok';
            btn.className = `ops-alert-button ${severity !== 'ok' ? `${severity} active` : ''}`;
            btn.textContent = alerts.length ? `ALERTA ${alerts.length}` : 'OK';
            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', state.opsAlertOpen ? 'true' : 'false');

            const title = alerts.length
                ? `${alerts.length} problema${alerts.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} encontrado${alerts.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}`
                : 'Nenhum problema principal';
            popover.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ops-alert-head">
                    <strong>${escapeHtml(title)}</strong>
                    <span class="badge ${hasBlocked ? 'red' : alerts.length ? 'orange' : 'green'}">${hasBlocked ? 'critico' : alerts.length ? 'atencao' : 'ok'}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="ops-alert-list">
                    ${alerts.length ? alerts.map((alert) => `
                        <div class="ops-alert-item ${escapeHtml(alert.kind)}">
	                            <div class="row">
	                                <strong>${escapeHtml(alert.label)}</strong>
	                                <span class="badge ${alert.kind === 'blocked' ? 'red' : 'orange'}">${escapeHtml(alert.source || alert.kind)}</span>
	                            </div>
	                            <div class="meta">${escapeHtml(alert.detail || 'Sem detalhe adicional.')}</div>
                                ${renderOperationalAlertClients(alert.items)}
	                        </div>
	                    `).join('') : '<div class="meta">WhatsApp, IA e rotinas principais sem alerta relevante.</div>'}
	                </div>

            popover.classList.toggle('hidden', !state.opsAlertOpen);

        const normalizeSessionsPayload = (payload) => {
            if (Array.isArray(payload?.sessions)) return payload.sessions;
            if (payload?.sessionId || payload?.status) return [payload];
            return [];
        };

        const requiredConnectionSlots = [
            { sessionId: '5515991418416', finalLabel: '8416' }
        ];

        const connectionAlertLabel = (alert) => ({
            stale: 'parado',
            waiting: 'aguardando',
            new: 'novo',
            active: 'ativo',
            idle: 'livre'
        }[String(alert || 'idle').toLowerCase()] || 'livre');

        const connectionWorkloadBySession = () => {
            const bySession = new Map();
            (state.connectionWorkload?.sessions || []).forEach((item) => {
                const key = digitsOnlyText(item.sessionId);
                if (key) bySession.set(key, item);
            });
            return bySession;
        };

        const normalizeConnectionStage = (value) => String(value || '')
            .normalize('NFD')
            .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_');

        const connectionCustomerNeedsCompletion = (customer = {}) => {
            const missing = Array.isArray(customer.missingFields)
                ? customer.missingFields.filter(Boolean)
                : [];
            if (missing.length > 0 && missing.length <= 2) return true;
            if (customer.almostReady || customer.needsCompletion) return true;
            const stage = normalizeConnectionStage(customer.stage || customer.status || '');
            return ['confirmado', 'comprar_depois', 'recompra'].includes(stage)
                && customer.dataComplete === false;
        };

        const renderConnectionStatusBlock = (item = {}, { compact = false } = {}) => {
            const customers = Array.isArray(item.customers) ? item.customers : [];

            const newToday = Number(item.newToday || 0);
            const waitingResponse = Number(item.waitingResponse || 0);

                    </div>

                </div>

        const renderConnectionOpsCard = (session, workloadBySession) => {
            const sessionKey = digitsOnlyText(session.ownPhoneDigits || session.sessionId);
            const item = workloadBySession.get(sessionKey) || workloadBySession.get(digitsOnlyText(session.sessionId)) || {};
            const alert = String(item.alert || 'idle').toLowerCase();
            const customers = Array.isArray(item.customers) ? item.customers : [];
            const rows = customers.length
                ? customers.map((customer) => {

                        ? new Date(customer.lastInteractionAt).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })

            return `
                <article class="connection-ops">

                        <div class="connection-metric"><strong>${Number(item.newToday || 0)}</strong><span>novos</span></div>
                        <div class="connection-metric"><strong>${Number(item.waitingResponse || 0)}</strong><span>aguardam</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="connection-ops-clients">${rows}</div>
                </article>

                ['ID GIRA', view.giraOrderId], ['Pedido Vitalismen', view.nativeOrderId] ];

        async function fetchPanelJson(path, options = {}) {
            const { label = path, ...fetchOptions } = options;
            const headers = {
                ...(state.token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${state.token}` } : {}),
                ...(fetchOptions.headers || {})
            };
            const response = await fetch(path, {
                cache: 'no-store',
                credentials: 'same-origin',
                ...fetchOptions,
                headers
            });
            const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
            const text = await response.text();
            let data = {};
            if (text) {
                try {
                    data = JSON.parse(text);
                } catch (parseError) {
                    const preview = cleanPanelResponsePreview(text);
                    const error = new Error(`${label}: resposta ${response.status || 'sem status'} nao JSON${preview ? ` (${preview})` : ''}`);
                    error.status = response.status;
                    error.contentType = contentType;
                    error.preview = preview;
                    throw error;
                }
            }
            if (!response.ok) {
                if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
                    setAuth('');
                    const error = new Error('Sessão expirada. Entre novamente.');
                    error.status = response.status;
                    error.response = data;
                    throw error;
                }
                const error = new Error(data.error || data.message || `${label}: erro ${response.status}`);
                error.status = response.status;
                error.response = data;
                throw error;
            }
            return data;
        }

        const zapiStatusGraceMs = 120000;

        async function checkStatus() {
            if (!state.token) {
                setSignedOutZapiState();
                renderOperationalAlerts();
                return;
            }
            try {
                const ts = Date.now();
                const zapiStatus = await fetchPanelJson(`/api/zapi/status?_=${ts}`, { label: 'Z-API status' });
                const statusData = zapiStatus?.status || {};
                const errorDetail = String(statusData.error || zapiStatus?.error || '').toLowerCase();
                const alreadyConnected = errorDetail.includes('already connected');
                const connected = Boolean(
                    zapiStatus?.ok
                    && statusData.connected === true
                    && statusData.smartphoneConnected !== false
                    && (statusData.session !== false || alreadyConnected)
                );
                const zapi = {
                    ...zapiStatus,
                    ok: connected,
                    error: connected ? '' : zapiStatus?.error,
                    device: zapiStatus?.device || {
                        phone: statusData.phone || '',
                        name: statusData.source || 'Z-API',
                        isBusiness: false,
                        originalDevice: '',
                        sessionName: ''
                    }
                };
                state.zapiDevice = zapi || null;
                if (connected) {
                    state.lastZapiOkAt = Date.now();
                    state.lastZapiSnapshot = zapi;
                    state.lastZapiStatusError = '';
                }
                const status = connected ? 'connected' : 'disconnected';
                document.body.classList.toggle('zapi-offline', !connected);

                el('waBadge').textContent = connected ? 'Z-API' : 'OFFLINE';
                el('waBadge').className = `badge ${badgeClass(status)}`;
                setZapiLoginState({ status: el('statusText'), image: el('qrcode'), help: el('qrHelp') }, zapi);
                setZapiLoginState({ status: el('loginStatusText'), image: el('loginQrcode'), help: el('loginQrHelp') }, zapi);
            } catch (error) {
                const now = Date.now();
                const hasFreshConnectedStatus = Boolean(state.lastZapiSnapshot?.ok && state.lastZapiOkAt && now - state.lastZapiOkAt < zapiStatusGraceMs);
                const message = error.message || 'Falha ao ler status Z-API';
                state.lastZapiStatusError = message;
                if (hasFreshConnectedStatus) {
                    document.body.classList.remove('zapi-offline');
                    el('waBadge').textContent = 'Z-API';
                    el('waBadge').className = 'badge green';
                    const staleStatus = {
                        ...state.lastZapiSnapshot,
                        transientStatusError: message
                    };
                    state.zapiDevice = staleStatus;
                    const lastTime = new Date(state.lastZapiOkAt).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR');
                    const stableText = `Z-API CONECTADO | ultima leitura ${lastTime}`;
                    el('statusText').textContent = stableText;
                    el('loginStatusText').textContent = stableText;
                    return;
                }
                document.body.classList.add('zapi-offline');
                el('waBadge').textContent = 'ERRO';
                el('waBadge').className = 'badge red';
                el('statusText').textContent = message;
                el('loginStatusText').textContent = message;
                state.zapiDevice = { ok: false, error: message };
            }
            renderOperationalAlerts();
        }

        const normalizeAlertKind = (kind = '') => {
            const value = String(kind || '').toLowerCase();
            if (['blocked', 'critical', 'error', 'red'].includes(value)) return 'blocked';
            if (['attention', 'warning', 'paused', 'orange'].includes(value)) return 'attention';
            return 'info';
        };

        const addOperationalAlert = (alerts, { kind = 'attention', label = 'Aviso', detail = '', source = '', items = [] } = {}) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAlertKind(kind);
            const key = `${normalized}:${label}:${detail}`;
            if (alerts.some((item) => item.key === key)) return;
            alerts.push({
                key,
                kind: normalized,
                label: String(label || 'Aviso'),
                detail: String(detail || ''),
                source: String(source || ''),
                items: Array.isArray(items) ? items : []
            });
        };

        const operationalAlertClientItem = ({ kind = '', phone = '', chatId = '', orderId = '', name = '', reason = '', detail = '' } = {}) => ({
            kind: String(kind || ''),
            phone: String(phone || '').replace(/\D/g, ''),
            chatId: String(chatId || ''),

            name: String(name || '').trim(),
            reason: String(reason || '').replace(/_/g, ' '),

        const buildOperationalAlerts = () => {
            const alerts = [];
            const zapi = state.zapiDevice;
            if (!zapi) {
                addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                    kind: 'attention',
                    label: 'WhatsApp verificando',
                    detail: 'Status da Z-API ainda nao carregou nesta tela.',
                    source: 'WhatsApp'
                });
            } else if (!zapi.ok) {
                addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                    kind: 'blocked',
                    label: 'WhatsApp desconectado',
                    detail: zapi.error || 'Z-API nao confirmou conexao do aparelho.',
                    source: 'WhatsApp'
                });

            const status = state.automationStatus;
            if (!status) {
                addOperationalAlert(alerts, {
                    kind: 'attention',
                    label: 'Automacao verificando',
                    detail: 'Status geral ainda nao carregou nesta tela.',
                    source: 'Automacao'
                });
                return alerts;
            }
